[i][b]The giant gazes westwards[/b][/i]

[i]The war in Astanir had expanded far beyond the Confederacy's expectation, with the large ramp up of Pax Int'l and the dissolution of the Democratic Front, Pantagruel was now pressured to militarily intervene in the conflict to safeguard its interests. Her occupation of the People's Army in the Southern Island Chain proved no real worth in levying a pro-Pantagruelic victory. The People's Army was failing, and so it had to be culled and salvaged in favour of a new order. 

PAA forces residing within the southern island chain were laid off and rebranded, each brandishing the insignia of a new faction, the [b]United Democratic Frontier[/b]. A new order, one that seeks to establish a de jure democratic state, that in reality adhered to the interests of the Confederacy. General Kang Jinrae, a prominent figure in the Pantagruelic Defence Forces, served a crucial role in the usurpation of Kim Jung Un and the defeat of the APLF in Hanuel. His immense experience and stoic mentality made him the perfect candidate to win the war, and by all means necessary. [b]All[/b].

Jinrae desired that the former People's Army of Astanir(PAA) work in tandem with the multiple dispersed tribes that littered the warzone, and to do so, both factions needed a strong channel of communication.  In the first few hours of his administration, he cancelled all diplomatic meetings in discussion of Astanir in Teremok, but refused to allow the leaders to leave. Instead, escorting them to the southernmost Island within the occupied archipelago. With both leaders in Pantagruelic custody, he'd then have them coerced into forming a shaky pact to form the first few ingredients needed to develop the UDF. Now with a legally binding defensive pact, he now focused on his secondary objective. [b]Reorganizing tribal and PAA forces to form the UDF[/b]. 

Argossian Tribal Militias were evacuated and then relocated to the Pantagrueli occupied Archipelago, where theyd rendezvous with the PAA to restock, resupply, and rebuild their chains of commands. A form of mutual agreement was engraved between the two sides under the management of the PDF, their command chains merged and integrated within one another. Now both entities operated under Jinrae and the UDF, as one. 

[b]The Lilypad Offensive[/b]

Now starting from square one again, the UDF heavily relied on Pantagrueli military support to rebuild its ranks. The Confederacy knew their time was finite, and so they had to act fast. A shock mobilization force of over 120,000 were brought into the ranks. 

The UDFs ambitious ideals veered towards the direction of the Restoration Front, which controlled islands that acted as synonymous springboards the UDF could use to get its bid back to the mainland. With numerous requests from the UDF, PDF finally agreed to operate airstrikes against the Astanir Restoration Front. Specific times and locations were devised for the strikes, weeks of prior espionage and surveillance proved crucial to pinpointing potential strike points.

Meanwhile, naval embankment platforms donated by Pantagruel were manned, each containing a mechanized platoon specialized for a quick amphibious offensive. BMP‑3F and 2S25 Sprut‑SD filled the selected attack groups. 

Within heavy military infrastrucutre camouflaged cold Shahab-3 Missile systems,  which were relaying information back and forth between PDF chain of command and the UDF, their targets were preemptively pinpointed and calculated. 

The strike was now, all components of the attack were fully operational and readied, shall the restoration front know hellfire.[/i]

[pre]
3:20 AM

Both amphibious military groups disembarked, their ships treading the water slowly to minimize radar detection. Each accompanied by a small force of gunboats that orbited the ships in fluent tandem. They kept watch of what was ahead of the horizon, with radars donated by Pantagruel that were strapped onto their bows that released deep electronic chirp ever couple moments, on their own, the radars struggled to track any fast movements, but in large groups, their chirps saturated the electric field. Allowing them to relay the location of an object one after another between each other. Once a hostile ship was detected, their position was uplinked to Pantagruelic F-14s cruising within the cloud cover, which theyd then quickly deploy their Anti-Ship missiles to neutralize the target as fast as possible. 

4:40 AM

In Persephone, the engines of F-111 Aardvarks roared to life, their burly frames slowly levitating into the rising dawn. Squadrons set off from Persephone State, their route tracing across cloudy wind cover. The Aardvarks bolted across the sky, shifting from cruising speed to full afterburner in a 5 second cycle. The constant cycling of the squadrons speed granted them the ability to reach a higher average speed, which proved critical in reaching the islands in time. 

5:30 AM

Missile trucks parked in uniform, their hatches locked and missiles eager. Hundreds of terabytes of data was uplinked to the systems of the missile trucks, locations, ETAs, civilian centers, all were listed.  This data was then translated into code, a language that the missile could read. And once Jinrae approved, the trucks lifted their arches. The hatch puffed open diffusing smoke everywhere, right after the missiles leaped into the air, gracefully flying until the short delay ended. Immediately their boosters screamed a mixture of burning fuel and gas, accelerating them into the air where they streaked across the sky. Over 40 missiles now littered the horizon, each headed to their own destination, roads, food centers, general headquarters, coastal positions, and fortifications. Their ETA certainly under 15 minutes.

7:20 AM

The Squadron of Aardvarks had now reached their targets, penetrating Restoration Frontieran Airspace with pure speed. As they accelerated, their wings gracefully swept, and their noses lowered towards the ground. As the aircraft reached within range of their targets, they released their payloads of GBU-12, 10, and 28 laser guided munitions. Immediately after, they turned up towards the sky, now free of their burdening payload the aircraft streamed back towards their airbases. The laser guided munitions struck their targets with surgical precision, each intended to destroy cores of the Restoration front's defenses. 

11:50 PM

With the attack already underway and Restoration Front defenses softened up, the amphibious assault force could now strike. Camouflaged under the darkness of the night, UDF gunboats harassed ARF lighthouse to distract them from the disembarking forces. The amphibious attack forces landed on rugged coastal terrain away from traditional roads where they believed the ARF would usually keep guard of. Once fully disembarked, the amphibious forces quickly reorganized into a convoy, where theyd then rendezvous behind ARF defensive positions onto the roads. The convoys moved in an orderly fashion, until they reached a road diversion, where theyd divert into small hunter killer teams set on destroying the ARF from the inside. With their vastly superior firepower and ordnance support, the UDF proved to be an undeniably powerful force. [/pre]

Jinrae's attack proved to be sensational and daring one, yet this was only the first of his multiple mayhems all across Astanir.

Nordiheimian Diplomat Æsir af Tyrsblood proudly anounces the new trade deal between the United Regions of Nordiheim and The [nation]Oceanice Republics[/nation], wich is rightfully ruled by the Enclave, wich reestablishes the flow of goods and services between the two great nations after many long days of intense discussion, drafting and renegotiation.

This trade deal allows Oceanice Enclave Republic to buy high purity Aluminium from Nordiheim in the form of either bars or semi-finished forms.
It is also contains corections in the wording and phrasing of its content compared to the old deal so as to be more tidy and understandable and avoid any misunderstandings or confusion from either side.

[spoiler=[b]The Nordiheimian and Oceanice Enclave Republic New Trade Deal of 27th of September 2025[/b]][align=center][b][u]The New Aircraft Trade[/u][/b][/align]

[align=center][b]Amended Trade deal between The United Territories of Nordiheim and The Oceanice Enclave Republic[/b][/align]
[align=center][i]====================================================[/i][/align]

[align=center][i][u]With this amended deal the two nations of Nordiheim and Oceanice Enclave Republic agree to adhere to the following agreements of trade:[/u][/i][/align]
[align=center][i][u]_N__________________________________E____________________________________W_[/u][/i][/align]

[align=center][b][i][u]Trade deal[/u][/i][/b][/align]
[u][b]1.a:[/b][/u] Both parties agree to open their civilian markets for free trade between each others nations, including their steel industries.

[u][b]1.b:[/b][/u] All trade are to be done in "good fait" and with fair prices based on world market prices on a quarterly basis.

[u][b]1.c:[/b][/u] If there should be a large change or upsett in the world economy the trade prices can be changed outside of the quarterly basis if both nations agree.

[b][u]1.d:[/u][/b] The Nordiheim agrees to give advantageous preferance to luxury goods made by Oceanice Republics companies over the luxury goods of other nations that is of the same type/function by giving them only 17% luxury tax instead of the normal 25%.

[align=center]++++++-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------++++++-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------++++++[/align]

[align=center][b][i][u]Military purchase and open military markets[/u][/i][/b][/align]
[u][b]2.a:[/b][/u] Nordiheim will buy 5 units of F-29 "The Hell Thunder" and 5 units of Eurofighter Typhoon 3000 (FT3000) from Oceanice Encalve Republic for a tottal of 1.3 billion $.

[b][u]2.b:[/u][/b] Oceanice Enclave Republic are also allowed a special deal to be able to buy 'SA-7 AXS' AA MANPADS, also known as FIM-92M Stinger in the Oceanice military, and general munitions over time as their need evolves on a quarterly basis.

[b][u]2.c:[/u][/b] Both nations agree to a open "purchase policy" between each other for future military trade/purchases of vehicles, material, munitions and parts as long as this trade deal remain valid.

[b][u]2.d:[/u][/b] The only exeption is if this trade/purchase of military vehicles, material or munitions were to be a direct treath to the national security of one of the signatories.

[b][u]2.e:[/u][/b] Both nations agree with the signing of this deal to deliver any remaining quanteties that are left of a allready agreed quarterly order if this trade deal were to be canceled for any reason exept for the event were one or both nations were to proclaim direct hostile intent or declare war ageinst the other or each other.

[align=center]++++++-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------++++++-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------++++++[/align]
[align=center][b][u]Amendment: Resource trade[/u][/b][/align]
[b][u]3.a:[/u][/b] Nordiheim agrees to open its Aluminium market to Oceanice for them to buy ore/bars as needed.

[b][u]3.b:[/u][/b] Oceanice Enclave Republic agrees to open its Oil and Gas market to Nordiheim for them to buy oil and gas as needed.

[b][u]3.c:[/u][/b] The price and purchase quantities of aluminium, oil and gas will be based on world market prices and be done on a quarterly basis.

[b][u]3.d:[/u][/b] The agreed upon prices and quantities can not be changed outside of this quarterly window unless both nations mutualy agree to it.

[align=center]++++++-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------++++++-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------++++++[/align]
[align=center][b][u]Special section:[/u][/b][/align]
[b][u]4:[/u][/b] Nordiheim or Oceanice Enclave Republics will have the right to terminate this agreement if either nations do the following:
a: Deny access to purchases, or other items outlined to be available to each nation in this deal!
b: Send aid to, supply, or in any way support enemies of either nations such as terrorist groups, pirates, or nations either signatory is actively at war with!
c: Take or declare hostile action or intent against the other signatory of this agreement!
d: Infringe upon the intellectual property of the aircraft, weapons, equipment or munitions sold in this agreement!
e: The EEHP places an embargo on the nation of Oceanice Republics!

[align=center]++++++-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------++++++-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------++++++[/align]
